about: Reference for task 10: what the two SurgicAI source files given to the model (RL/Approach_env.py and the first 10,000 characters of RL/subtask_env.py, at the pinned commit) state about the policy interface, read by hand. 'stated': false means the files do not state it, and the right output is an empty field. 'must_contain' lists what a correct value has to contain, compared in lower case.

action_step_size.why: the constructor's default is step_size=None; the value is passed in by training scripts that are not among the files

control_rate_hz.why: no rate appears in either file

training_start_range.why: the only limits in the files are in commented-out lines of the reset function
